# Acriotech Global Pvt. Ltd.

> Enterprise software, AI, cloud and automation engineering — Bhavnagar HQ, global delivery (IN/US/GB/AE/EU). Fixed-price, SOC2-ready, 12-week first release.

Acriotech is an enterprise software engineering company in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India (14, Shiv Narayan Complex, Virani Circle, Kaliyabid, 364002). We partner with mid-market and enterprise organisations worldwide to design, engineer and evolve mission-critical enterprise software, AI platforms, business process automation and cloud infrastructure that carry the weight of the business. Engineering in Bhavnagar, contracts global — SLA 15m S1 / 1hr S2 / 24hr S3. Pricing: From $40k module • $140-350k platform — custom scoped in 24h.

## Solutions

- [Enterprise Software Development](https://acriotech.com/solutions/enterprise-software): Mission-critical applications engineered for stability, security and scale — event-driven microservices (Kafka/RabbitMQ), RBAC/SSO, audit logging, zero-trust. SOC2-ready, GDPR/HIPAA aligned.
- [AI & Intelligent Automation](https://acriotech.com/solutions/ai-intelligent-automation): Enterprise AI with strict operational bounds — document processing, forecasting, anomaly detection, human-in-loop thresholds, MLOps (Airflow), LLM integration hosted in your environment.
- [Business Process Automation](https://acriotech.com/solutions/business-process-automation): Automation platforms that make workflows reliable, auditable and traceable — approvals, order-to-cash, compliance trails. Email chain → centralized platform.
- [Cloud Infrastructure](https://acriotech.com/solutions/cloud-infrastructure): Resilient, high-availability multi-region cloud & Kubernetes (Terraform IaC), auto-scaling to 15M+ daily requests, 99.99% SLA, FinOps cost optimization, zero-downtime deploys.
- [Legacy System Modernization](https://acriotech.com/solutions/legacy-system-modernization): Safe zero-downtime migration — monolith → microservices, strangler fig pattern, data migration with integrity checks.
- [Data Analytics & Engineering](https://acriotech.com/solutions/data-analytics): Analytics pipelines, BI, data warehousing, real-time dashboards, governance. From raw data to decisions.
- [Digital Transformation](https://acriotech.com/solutions/digital-transformation): End-to-end digital transformation — strategy, architecture, delivery, change management.
- [Custom Software Development](https://acriotech.com/solutions/custom-software-development): Bespoke software built for your exact operational reality — React/Next.js, Node/Go/Rust, Python.

## Services

- [Software Consulting](https://acriotech.com/services/software-consulting): Senior technical advisory when the path is unclear — architecture reviews, feasibility, roadmapping.
- [Product Discovery](https://acriotech.com/services/product-discovery): Requirements, exploration, prototyping before build.
- [UI/UX Design](https://acriotech.com/services/ui-ux-design): Design systems, product design for complex enterprise workflows.
- [Web Application Development](https://acriotech.com/services/web-application-development): Responsive, secure, scalable web apps — React/Next.js, Node/Go, GraphQL/REST, component-driven architecture.
- [Mobile App Development](https://acriotech.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native & cross-platform mobile (React Native, Flutter).
- [API Development & Integration](https://acriotech.com/services/api-development-integration): Resilient REST/GraphQL APIs, rate-limited, monitored, documented — integrate SAP/Oracle/Salesforce/legacy.
- [Cloud Architecture](https://acriotech.com/services/cloud-architecture): Multi-region cloud, Terraform, Kubernetes, zero-downtime.
- [DevOps & CI/CD](https://acriotech.com/services/devops-ci-cd): Pipelines, IaC (Terraform/Ansible), automated testing, observability.
- [AI Integration](https://acriotech.com/services/ai-integration): Integrate AI / ML into existing products with governance.
- [QA & Testing](https://acriotech.com/services/qa-testing): Automated + manual QA matched to cost of failure.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://acriotech.com/services/maintenance-support): SLA-backed support, proactive monitoring, continuous delivery.
- [Dedicated Development Teams](https://acriotech.com/services/dedicated-development-teams): Extend capacity with a dedicated pod in Bhavnagar — fixed price or T&M.
